newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia share trade down, interest seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Estonia share trade down, interest seen rising.

text.p: Trade on the Estonian bourse fell away on Friday but dealers were confident that with May bank results interest will be rekindled.
Total trade on the main list was 24 million kroons with the Talse 0.26 percent stronger at 251.48.
"Interest was certainly down, but with the May bank results due out next week interest and speculation should be higher," one trader said.
"However, any gains in prices may not hold, because in summer clients and brokers have more time to consider fundamentals of a company," he added.
Hoiupank turned over 10.5 million kroons to end on 132.25 kroons, up 0.85 kroons.
Hansapank saw a reduced trade of 3.3 million kroons to be 0.50 kroons higher to end at 129.00 kroons.
The free market turned over 6.2 million kroons with Kalev the most active.
Kalev closed on 1,690 kroons, a fall of 25 15.00 kroons after trade of 3.9 million kroons.
"Kalev is a little bit misleading as the price of the stock means that any small trades will appear big," one dealer said.
